title: Special Act on Support for and Post-Expo Utilization of the 2028 Ulsan International Garden Expo
title_original: 2028 울산국제정원박람회 지원 및 사후활용에 관한 특별법
full_text:
SPECIAL ACT ON SUPPORT FOR AND POST-EXPO UTILIZATION OF THE 2028 ULSAN INTERNATIONAL GARDEN EXPO

CHAPTER I GENERAL PROVISIONS

Article 1 (Purpose)
The purpose of this Act is to support the successful holding of the 2028 Ulsan International Garden Expo and to promote the domestic garden industry and invigorate garden culture by efficiently utilizing Expo facilities after the Expo ends, thereby contributing to enabling everyone to lead healthy and sustainable lives in harmony with nature.

Article 2 (Definitions)
The terms used in this Act are defined as follows:
1. The term "Expo-related facilities" means facilities directly related to the Expo, Expo support facilities, and facilities for post-Expo utilization in connection with the 2028 Ulsan International Garden Expo (hereinafter referred to as the "Expo");
2. The term "facilities directly related to the Expo" means any of the following facilities:
   (a) Gardens and thematic exhibition halls;
   (b) Experiential facilities and amenities associated with such facilities;
   (c) Facilities for operating and managing the Expo;
   (d) Electricity, electronics, telecommunications, and gas facilities;
   (e) Other facilities directly related to the Expo that are prescribed by Presidential Decree;
3. The term "Expo support facilities" means any of the following facilities:
   (a) Transportation facilities, including major roads, that need to be constructed or improved for operating the Expo and establishing access networks;
   (b) Facilities for cultural and artistic performances;
   (c) Facilities for creating urban landscapes in the vicinity of the Expo grounds;
   (d) Publicity and information facilities;
   (e) Road signs related to facilities directly related to the Expo;
   (f) Other facilities necessary to create conditions for the Expo that are prescribed by Presidential Decree;
4. The term "facilities for post-Expo utilization" means any of the following facilities developed for post-Expo utilization:
   (a) Facilities managed and operated by an entity responsible for post-Expo utilization;
   (b) Multipurpose facilities linked to facilities directly related to the Expo;
   (c) Other facilities related to post-Expo utilization that are prescribed by Presidential Decree;
5. The term "post-Expo utilization" means efficiently managing facilities directly related to the Expo, Expo support facilities, and facilities for utilizing them after the Expo is held (including sale, lease, and development), and carrying out projects commemorating the Expo and other related projects.

Article 3 (Relationship to Other Acts)
The provisions of this Act applicable to projects concerning the establishment, use, post-Expo utilization, etc. of Expo-related facilities shall take precedence over other Acts.

Article 4 (Responsibilities of the State and Local Governments)
(1) The State and local governments shall formulate and implement comprehensive policies and devise measures to provide support so that the Expo can be held successfully.
(2) The State and local governments shall take measures necessary to ensure that the Expo is operated safely and conveniently.

CHAPTER II ORGANIZING COMMITTEE FOR THE EXPO

Article 5 (Establishment of the Organizing Committee for the Expo)
(1) The Organizing Committee for the 2028 Ulsan International Garden Expo (hereinafter referred to as the "Organizing Committee") shall be established with authorization from the Administrator of the Korea Forest Service for the preparation, successful holding, and post-Expo utilization of the Expo.
(2) The Organizing Committee shall be an incorporated foundation and shall be established upon registration of its establishment at the location of its principal office.
(3) The Organizing Committee shall perform the following duties for the preparation, successful holding, and post-Expo utilization of the Expo:
1. Formulating and implementing a comprehensive plan and detailed operating plans for the Expo;
2. Establishing and managing Expo-related facilities;
3. Cooperating with countries participating in the Expo, the Bureau International des Expositions, and the International Association of Horticultural Producers;
4. Other projects necessary for the smooth preparation, operation, and post-Expo utilization of the Expo.
(4) The Organizing Committee shall have a chairperson, vice chairperson, executive members, and auditors as its officers, and shall have an executive committee to conduct its affairs efficiently.
(5) A secretariat shall be established to handle the affairs of the Organizing Committee.
(6) Matters necessary for the number, terms of office, and methods of election of the officers under paragraph (4), the composition and functions of the executive committee, and the organization and operation of the secretariat under paragraph (5) shall be prescribed by the articles of incorporation.
(7) Except as provided in this Act, the provisions of the Civil Act concerning incorporated foundations shall apply mutatis mutandis to the Organizing Committee.

Article 6 (Acceptance of Donations of Money and Goods)
(1) Notwithstanding Article 5 (2) of the Act on the Collection and Use of Donations and Promotion of a Culture of Giving, the Organizing Committee may accept voluntarily donated money and goods to the extent consistent with the purposes of its activities.
(2) Matters necessary for the procedures for accepting donations of money and goods under paragraph (1) and other related matters shall be prescribed by Presidential Decree.

Article 7 (Counterterrorism and Safety Measures, etc.)
(1) The Organizing Committee may request support from the State to prepare for terrorism and safety threats to Expo-related facilities, persons working at the Expo, visitors, etc.
(2) The State may formulate counterterrorism and safety measures to provide support for matters requested by the Organizing Committee under paragraph (1).
(3) Matters necessary for the specific division of duties between the Organizing Committee and relevant administrative agencies under paragraphs (1) and (2), the formulation of counterterrorism and safety measures, and other related matters shall be prescribed by Presidential Decree.

Article 8 (Establishment of the Fund, etc.)
(1) An Expo fund (hereinafter referred to as the "Fund") shall be established within the Organizing Committee to cover expenses necessary for the establishment and operation of the Organizing Committee and the preparation and operation of the Expo.
(2) The Fund shall be financed from the following sources:
1. Government subsidies;
2. Contributions and donations of money and goods from persons other than the Government;
3. Borrowed funds under Article 9;
4. Proceeds from revenue-generating businesses under Article 11;
5. Proceeds from outdoor advertising businesses provided to the Organizing Committee under Article 6 (5) of the Act on the Management of Outdoor Advertisements, etc. and Promotion of Outdoor Advertisement Industry;
6. Income generated from the operation of the Fund;
7. Other income.
(3) The fiscal year of the Fund shall coincide with the fiscal year of the Government.
(4) The accounts of the Fund shall be processed in accordance with the principles of business accounting.
(5) Other matters necessary for the operation and management of the Fund shall be prescribed by Presidential Decree.

Article 9 (Borrowing of Funds, etc.)
(1) When necessary for the preparation and operation of the Expo, the Organizing Committee may, with approval from the Administrator of the Korea Forest Service, borrow funds or obtain supplies (including borrowing funds or obtaining supplies from international organizations, foreign governments, foreigners, etc.).
(2) Where the Organizing Committee borrows funds or obtains supplies from abroad, it shall comply with the Act on the Introduction and Management of Public Loans or the Foreign Exchange Transactions Act.

Article 10 (Exemption from the Obligation to Purchase Bonds, etc.)
Where the Organizing Committee acquires movable or immovable property or engages in similar transactions for its operation and activities, it shall be exempted, in the same manner as State agencies, from the obligation to purchase various bonds, etc. required to be purchased under relevant Acts.

Article 11 (Revenue-Generating Businesses)
(1) To cover expenses necessary for the preparation, operation, and post-Expo utilization of the Expo, the Organizing Committee may engage in the following revenue-generating businesses with approval from the Administrator of the Korea Forest Service:
1. Businesses involving emblems;
2. Sale of commemorative coins;
3. Rental of Expo facilities and commemorative projects;
4. Sale of admission tickets for the Expo and cultural and artistic events related to the Expo;
5. Garden tourism, garden culture, and garden therapy businesses using Expo-related facilities and sites;
6. Businesses for promoting health and physical fitness and for sporting activities using Expo-related facilities and sites;
7. Other businesses related to the Expo that are prescribed by Presidential Decree.
(2) The Organizing Committee may distribute part of the funds raised through revenue-generating businesses to other institutions, corporations, or organizations related to the Expo, as prescribed by Presidential Decree.

Article 12 (Issuance of Commemorative Coins, etc.)
(1) The Organizing Committee may request the Bank of Korea to issue commemorative coins to cover expenses necessary for the preparation and operation of the Expo.
(2) The Organizing Committee may acquire on an exclusive basis the commemorative coins issued under paragraph (1).

Article 13 (Issuance of Commemorative Stamps, etc.)
The Organizing Committee may request the Minister of Science and ICT to issue commemorative postage stamps or postal cards to publicize or commemorate the Expo.

Article 14 (Fees, etc.)
When conducting duties for the Expo or other projects related to the Expo, the Organizing Committee may collect fees or charges for use, as prescribed by Presidential Decree, in any of the following cases:
1. Where it allows the use of Expo-related facilities or goods under its management;
2. Where it provides services to an individual, corporation, or organization;
3. Other cases prescribed by Presidential Decree.

Article 15 (Budget Documents, etc.)
The Organizing Committee shall prepare a project plan and budget documents for the following year and obtain approval from the Administrator of the Korea Forest Service no later than one month before the commencement of the following fiscal year. The same shall also apply when it intends to amend them.

Article 16 (Reports on Settlement of Accounts, etc.)
The Organizing Committee shall submit to the Administrator of the Korea Forest Service, by March 31 of the following year, a report on the settlement of revenue and expenditure accounts for each fiscal year, accompanied by the results of its activities for the relevant year.

Article 17 (Attribution of Residual Assets)
Article 13 of the Act on the Establishment and Operation of Public Interest Corporations shall apply mutatis mutandis to the attribution of residual assets where the Organizing Committee is dissolved. In such cases, the residual assets shall be made available for post-Expo utilization included in the project plan under Article 24.

Article 18 (Support from the State, etc.)
(1) The State or a local government may provide budgetary support to the Organizing Committee to cover expenses necessary for the establishment and operation of the Organizing Committee, the preparation for and operation of the Expo, the maintenance and management of facilities associated with the Expo venue, etc.
(2) The Organizing Committee may request administrative cooperation, financial support, and other necessary assistance from the State, local governments, public institutions (meaning public institutions under Article 4 of the Act on the Management of Public Institutions; hereinafter the same shall apply), etc., and the institutions concerned shall cooperate to the fullest extent possible unless there is a special reason not to do so.
(3) The State, local governments, and the Organizing Committee may provide administrative and financial support necessary for the activities of private organizations and local residents to promote public participation, cultural civic awareness, etc. for the successful holding of the Expo.

Article 19 (Lending of State or Public Property, etc.)
(1) Where necessary to support the Organizing Committee, the State or a local government may, to the extent that the intended use of the property is not impeded, lend State or public property free of charge or permit the Organizing Committee to use such property and derive profits therefrom free of charge, or transfer office supplies or other goods free of charge or permit the Organizing Committee to use them free of charge.
(2) Where property or goods are lent, made available for use and profit free of charge, or transferred pursuant to paragraph (1), the details, conditions, procedures, etc. shall be determined by an agreement between the agency managing the relevant property or goods and the Organizing Committee.

Article 20 (Requests for Secondment of Public Officials, etc.)
(1) Where the Organizing Committee deems it necessary for the performance of its duties, it may, with approval from the Administrator of the Korea Forest Service, request relevant administrative agencies, local governments, or corporations or organizations related to the Expo to second public officials under Article 2 (2) of the State Public Officials Act and Article 2 (2) of the Local Public Officials Act, or executive officers and employees of such corporations or organizations.
(2) Where the head of an institution that has seconded a public official or an executive officer or employee pursuant to paragraph (1) intends to terminate the secondment during the period of secondment, he or she shall consult with the Organizing Committee in advance: Provided, That Article 30-4 of the Local Public Officials Act shall apply to the secondment of public officials appointed for fixed terms under Article 25-5 of that Act, notwithstanding Article 3 (4) of that Act.
(3) The head of a relevant administrative agency, local government, corporation, or organization that has seconded a public official or an executive officer or employee pursuant to paragraph (2) shall not treat the seconded person unfavorably in matters of promotion, transfer, training, awards, welfare benefits, etc.
(4) Where the Organizing Committee deems a seconded public official or executive officer or employee unsuitable for the performance of duties, it may request the relevant administrative agency, local government, corporation, or organization that seconded the public official or executive officer or employee to terminate the secondment.

Article 21 (Requests for Provision of Materials)
(1) The Organizing Committee may request relevant administrative agencies, public institutions, educational institutions, research organizations, etc. to provide materials related to the Expo, such as survey reports and research papers.
(2) The head of an institution or organization in receipt of a request under paragraph (1) shall comply with it unless there is a special reason not to do so.

CHAPTER III INSTALLATION, USE, AND POST-EXPO UTILIZATION OF EXPO-RELATED FACILITIES, ETC.

Article 22 (Establishment of Working Committee, etc.)
(1) The Government Working Committee for the 2028 Ulsan International Garden Expo (hereinafter referred to as the "Working Committee") shall be established under the Korea Forest Service to deliberate on and coordinate policies related to the installation, use, post-Expo utilization, etc. of Expo-related facilities.
(2) The Working Committee shall consist of not more than 30 members, including a chairperson, and the Deputy Administrator of the Korea Forest Service shall serve as the chairperson.
(3) Matters necessary for the composition and operation of the Working Committee, other than those provided for in paragraphs (1) and (2), shall be prescribed by Presidential Decree.

Article 23 (Support for Expo-related Facilities, etc.)
(1) The State or a local government may subsidize all or part of the project costs necessary for the new construction, reconstruction, or repair of Expo-related facilities.
(2) The State or a local government may implement projects for Expo-related facilities on a priority basis in time for the holding of the Expo, as prescribed by Presidential Decree.

Article 24 (Formulation and Implementation of Plans for Installation, Use, and Post-Expo Utilization of Expo-related Facilities, etc.)
(1) The Organizing Committee and the Mayor of Ulsan Metropolitan City (hereinafter referred to as the "Mayor") shall formulate a plan for the installation, use, post-Expo utilization, etc. of Expo-related facilities (hereinafter referred to as a "project plan") and obtain approval from the Administrator of the Korea Forest Service for the successful holding of the Expo. In such cases, the Organizing Committee and the Mayor shall take into account the surrounding environmental conditions and geographical characteristics so that Expo-related facilities can be installed and used in an environmentally friendly manner.
(2) Where the Administrator of the Korea Forest Service intends to approve a project plan, he or she shall have it deliberated on by the Working Committee after prior consultation with the heads of the relevant central administrative agencies. Upon approving the project plan, the Administrator of the Korea Forest Service shall forward the documents to the Organizing Committee and the Mayor, and the Organizing Committee and the Mayor shall give public notice thereof.
(3) Matters necessary for the formulation and public notice of project plans, etc. shall be prescribed by Presidential Decree.
(4) Paragraphs (1) and (2) shall apply mutatis mutandis where a project plan approved under paragraph (1) is to be amended: Provided, That this shall not apply to amendments to minor matters prescribed by Presidential Decree.

Article 25 (Designation of Development Project Areas)
(1) The Mayor shall designate development project areas and give public notice thereof in accordance with the project plan approved under Article 24.
(2) Where the Mayor intends to designate a development project area pursuant to paragraph (1) or modify a designated development project area, he or she shall consult with the heads of the relevant central administrative agencies, as prescribed by Presidential Decree: Provided, That this shall not apply to changes to minor matters prescribed by Presidential Decree.
(3) Where the Mayor designates or modifies a development project area pursuant to paragraphs (1) and (2), he or she shall publish the relevant documents, including topographical drawings under Article 8 (2) of the Framework Act on the Regulation of Land Use, in the official gazette and make them available for inspection by residents within his or her jurisdiction for at least 14 days.

Article 26 (Special Provisions on Approval of Project Plans)
Where a project plan is approved, the formulation of plans and other acts specified in the following subparagraphs shall be deemed to have taken place:
1. Formulation of a master reclamation plan under Article 22 of the Public Waters Management and Reclamation Act;
2. Formulation and submission of a medium-term local finance plan under Article 33 (1) of the Local Finance Act and review of fiscal investment projects under Article 37 of that Act.

Article 27 (Implementers of Projects for Installation, Use, and Post-Expo Utilization of Expo-related Facilities, etc.)
The Organizing Committee and the Mayor may directly implement projects for the installation, use, post-Expo utilization, etc. of Expo-related facilities, or designate any of the following persons as a project implementer (hereinafter referred to as a "project implementer") to implement such projects:
1. A public institution prescribed by Presidential Decree;
2. A local public corporation under the Local Public Enterprises Act;
3. Where a project is implemented as a public-private partnership project pursuant to the Act on Public-Private Partnerships in Infrastructure, a project implementer prescribed in that Act;
4. Any other project implementer prescribed by Presidential Decree.

Article 28 (Approval of Implementation Plans)
(1) Where approval under Article 24 has been granted, a project implementer shall prepare an implementation plan that includes the scale and details of the Expo-related facilities project, the project period, the financing plan, and other matters prescribed by Presidential Decree, and obtain approval thereof from the Mayor; the same shall also apply where the project implementer intends to amend the implementation plan: Provided, That this shall not apply to amendments to minor matters prescribed by Presidential Decree.
(2) Where the Mayor approves an implementation plan or an amendment thereto, the Mayor shall, without delay, give public notice thereof in the official gazette and make it available for public inspection for at least 14 days.

Article 29 (Restrictions on Activities, etc.)
From the date on which public notice of approval of an implementation plan under Article 28 is given, within a development project area, no permission for development activities under Article 56 of the National Land Planning and Utilization Act may be granted, no permission may be granted or report filed for buildings or temporary buildings as prescribed in the Building Act, and no report on the construction of structures may be filed: Provided, That this shall not apply where the head of the competent local government grants permission or accepts a report upon determining that the installation, use, and post-Expo utilization of Expo-related facilities will not be hindered.

Article 30 (Deemed Authorization or Permission under Other Acts)
(1) Where a project implementer obtains approval of an implementation plan or approval of an amendment thereto under Article 28, the project implementer shall be deemed to have obtained or completed the permissions, authorizations, determinations, cancellations, designations, approvals, consultations, deliberations, reports, etc. listed in the following subparagraphs (hereinafter referred to as "authorizations, permissions, etc."); upon public notice of such approval, the public notices or announcements of the authorizations, permissions, etc. under the Acts listed in the following subparagraphs shall be deemed to have been given or made:
1. Deliberation by a building committee under Article 4 of the Building Act; a building permit under Article 11 of that Act; a building report under Article 14 of that Act; amendments to matters covered by a permit or report under Article 16 of that Act; a change of use under Article 19 of that Act; permission for or reporting on a temporary building under Article 20 of that Act; consultation on construction under Article 29 of that Act; and a report on the construction of a structure under Article 83 of that Act;
2. A report on the commencement, modification, or completion of a project under Article 86(1) of the Act on the Establishment and Management of Spatial Data;
3. Permission to occupy or use public waters under Article 8 of the Public Waters Management and Reclamation Act; approval of an implementation plan under Article 17 of that Act; a license to reclaim public waters under Article 28 of that Act; public notice of a license under Article 33 of that Act; consultation or approval under Articles 35 and 36 of that Act; and approval and public notice of an implementation plan for public waters reclamation under Article 38 of that Act;
4. Permission for use and profit-making under Article 20 of the Public Property and Commodity Management Act;
5. Permission to use State property under Article 30 of the State Property Act;
6. Determination of an urban or Gun management plan under Article 30 of the National Land Planning and Utilization Act; public notice of topographic drawings under Article 32 of that Act; permission for development activities under Article 56 of that Act; designation of a project implementer under Article 86 of that Act; and authorization of an implementation plan under Article 88 of that Act;
7. Approval for special construction under Article 16 of the Tramway Transportation Act;
8. Permission for or consultation on the conversion of farmland under Article 34 of the Farmland Act;
9. Permission to execute road works under Article 36 of the Road Act; permission to occupy a road under Article 61 of that Act; and consultation with or approval from a road management authority under Article 107 of that Act;
10. Designation of an urban development zone under Article 3 of the Urban Development Act; formulation of a development plan under Article 4 of that Act; designation of a project implementer under Article 11 of that Act; and authorization of an implementation plan under Article 17 of that Act;
11. Permission to occupy an urban park under Article 24 of the Act on Urban Parks and Green Areas; and permission to occupy a green area under Article 38 of that Act;
12. Permission for or reporting on the felling of standing timber, etc. under Article 36(1) and (5) of the Creation and Management of Forest Resources Act;
13. Permission for the conversion of a mountainous district under Article 14 of the Mountainous Districts Management Act; a report on the conversion of a mountainous district under Article 15 of that Act; permission for or reporting on the temporary use of a mountainous district under Article 15-2 of that Act; and permission to collect earth or stone under Article 25 of that Act;
14. Formulation and approval of a comprehensive plan for small river maintenance and formulation of an implementation plan for small river maintenance under Articles 6 and 8 of the Small River Maintenance Act; permission to execute small river works under Article 10 of that Act; and permission for or reporting on the occupation of small rivers, etc. under Article 14 of that Act;
15. Authorization for a waterworks business under Article 17 or 49 of the Water Supply and Waterworks Installation Act;
16. Approval of an arboretum development plan under Article 7 of the Act on the Creation and Furtherance of Arboretums and Gardens; and designation or cancellation of designation of sites scheduled for garden development, formulation of a national garden development plan, and approval of a garden development plan under Article 18-2 of that Act;
17. Permission to relocate unclaimed graves under Article 27(1) of the Act on Funeral Services;
18. Approval of a project plan under Article 12 of the Installation and Utilization of Sports Facilities Act;
19. Authorization to install public sewerage systems under Article 11 of the Sewerage Act; permission to execute public sewerage works under Article 16 of that Act; and permission to occupy public sewerage systems under Article 24 of that Act;
20. Consultation with or approval from a river management authority under Article 6 of the River Act; permission to execute river works under Article 30 of that Act; permission to occupy a river under Article 33 of that Act; and permission to use river water under Article 50 of that Act.
(2) Where the Mayor approves an implementation plan or an amendment thereto under Article 28, if the implementation plan includes any matter falling under any subparagraph of paragraph (1), the Mayor shall consult in advance with the heads of the relevant administrative agencies, and the heads of the relevant administrative agencies shall submit their opinions within 30 days from the date on which they receive a request for consultation.

Article 31 (Expropriation or Use of Land, etc.)
(1) A project implementer may, where necessary to implement a project, expropriate or use the land, objects, and rights under Article 3 of the Act on Acquisition of and Compensation for Land, etc. for Public Works Projects (hereinafter referred to as "expropriation, etc.").
(2) Where public notice of approval of an implementation plan under Article 28(2) is given, project recognition and public notice thereof under Articles 20(1) and 22 of the Act on Acquisition of and Compensation for Land, etc. for Public Works Projects shall be deemed to have been granted and given, and an application for adjudication may be filed within the project period specified in the implementation plan under Article 28 of this Act, notwithstanding Articles 23(1) and 28(1) of that Act.
(3) The Central Land Tribunal shall be the land tribunal having jurisdiction over adjudication on the expropriation, etc. of land, etc. under paragraph (1).
(4) Except as otherwise specifically provided in this Act, the Act on Acquisition of and Compensation for Land, etc. for Public Works Projects shall apply mutatis mutandis to the expropriation, etc. of land, etc. under paragraph (1).

CHAPTER IV PROHIBITION ON THE USE OF EMBLEMS AND SIMILAR NAMES

Article 32 (Use of Expo Emblems, etc.)
Any person intending to display on merchandise or other items an emblem or mascot designated by the Organizing Committee, or any similar symbol representing the Expo, or to use it for advertising or any other profit-making purpose, shall obtain approval from the Organizing Committee: Provided, That this shall not apply where it is used by a holder of rights registered under the Trademark Act and the Design Protection Act.

Article 33 (Prohibition on the Use of Similar Names)
No person other than the Organizing Committee under this Act shall use the name "Organizing Committee for the 2028 Ulsan International Garden Expo" or any similar name.

CHAPTER V SUPPLEMENTARY PROVISIONS

Article 34 (Delegation of Authority)
(1) The head of a central administrative agency may delegate part of his or her authority under this Act to the Mayor, as prescribed by Presidential Decree.
(2) Where the Mayor handles affairs prescribed by Presidential Decree among the affairs delegated under paragraph (1), the Mayor shall consult in advance with the head of the relevant central administrative agency.
(3) The Mayor may delegate part of his or her authority under this Act to the head of a Gu (referring to the head of an autonomous Gu; hereinafter the same shall apply) or the head of a Gun, as prescribed by Presidential Decree.
(4) Where the head of a Gu or the head of a Gun handles affairs prescribed by Presidential Decree among the affairs delegated under paragraph (3), he or she shall consult in advance with the Mayor.

Article 35 (Deemed Public Officials for Purposes of Applying Penalty Provisions)
Officers and employees of the Organizing Committee and officers and employees dispatched to the Organizing Committee from a corporation or organization under Article 20(1) shall be deemed public officials when the penalty provisions under Articles 127 and 129 through 132 of the Criminal Act are applied.

CHAPTER VI PENALTY PROVISIONS

Article 36 (Penalty Provisions)
Any person who uses an emblem or other symbol in violation of Article 32 shall be punished by a fine not exceeding 20 million won.

Article 37 (Administrative Fines)
(1) Any person who uses the name "Organizing Committee for the 2028 Ulsan International Garden Expo" or any similar name in violation of Article 33 shall be subject to an administrative fine not exceeding three million won.
(2) The administrative fines under paragraph (1) shall be imposed and collected by the Administrator of the Korea Forest Service, as prescribed by Presidential Decree.

ADDENDA <Act No. 21400, February 27, 2026>

Article 1 (Enforcement Date)
This Act shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation: Provided, That Article 2 (limited to facilities prescribed by Presidential Decree), Articles 6 through 8, Article 11(1)7 and (2), Article 14, Article 22, Article 23(2), Articles 24 through 30, Article 34, and Article 37 shall enter into force on the date six months have elapsed after its promulgation.

Article 2 (Period of Validity)
This Act shall remain effective until December 31, 2029.

Article 3 (Transitional Measures concerning the Organizing Committee)
(1) Where an Organizing Committee established as an incorporated foundation under Article 32 of the Civil Act exists at the time this Act enters into force, the Organizing Committee under Article 5 shall be deemed to have been established.
(2) Acts performed in the course of its duties in connection with preparations for the Expo, including the installation of Expo-related facilities, by an Organizing Committee established under Article 32 of the Civil Act and existing at the time this Act enters into force, or acts performed in relation to that Organizing Committee, shall be deemed acts performed by or in relation to the Organizing Committee under this Act.
(3) Officers and employees of an Organizing Committee established as an incorporated foundation under Article 32 of the Civil Act shall be deemed officers and employees of the Organizing Committee under this Act, and the terms of office of the officers shall be calculated from the dates of their previous appointments.

Article 4 (Transitional Measures concerning Property Contributed to the Organizing Committee, etc.)
Money and other property provided as contributions, subsidies, or donations, as at the time this Act enters into force, by the State, a local government, an individual, a corporation, or any other organization for the establishment and operation of an Organizing Committee established as an incorporated foundation under Article 32 of the Civil Act shall be deemed contributions, subsidies, or donations of money or goods under Article 8(2).

Article 5 (Transitional Measures concerning Public Officials and Officers and Employees Dispatched to the Organizing Committee)
Public officials or officers and employees who, at the time this Act enters into force, have been dispatched by the State, a local government, a corporation, or any other organization to an Organizing Committee established as an incorporated foundation under Article 32 of the Civil Act shall be deemed public officials or officers and employees dispatched under Article 20(1).

Article 6 (Transitional Measures concerning Approval of Project Plans, etc.)
Where a project plan and an implementation plan have been finalized before this Act enters into force, approval of the project plan and the implementation plan under Articles 24 and 28 shall be deemed to have been granted.

Article 7 (Amendment to Another Act)
The Framework Act on the Regulation of Land Use is partially amended as follows.
